scratch: Inspect internal thread crests under 10× optical magnifier; verify thread pitch with Go/No-Go plug gauge.
Examine outer hexagon flats under 45° directional shadow lighting for scratch depth and burrs.
bent: Check hexagon flats and bearing face perpendicularity on granite surface plate with dial indicator.
Inspect flange rim under optical comparator against master nut profile for deformation.
flip: Verify fixture seating and seating pin alignment, then recapture in correct orientation.
Inspect primary bearing face contact pattern against reference master nut.
discoloration: Examine highlighted surface under 5000K diffuse illumination for plating voids, oxidation, or chemical staining.
Verify anti-corrosion coating thickness and surface finish against reference master nut.
unknown: Manually inspect the highlighted region with 10× loupe and compare with calibrated reference nut.
uncertain: Perform full-envelope visual and dimensional verification across all nut faces and thread opening.
inner_rim: Inspect internal thread crests and lead-in chamfer for tooling marks, shearing, or chip buildup.
camera: Verify part alignment and illumination in jig, then recapture frame for defect confirmation.
screen_photo: Use original calibrated image capture for benchmark inspection.
